title: The Mud-Pie Mischief at Curtain Call
intro: Ten minutes before opening night, the lead actor's costume has been swapped and the prop cake has vanished from the community theater's green room.

suspects.name: Rory
suspects.line: I was on the stage painting the backdrop. Ask anyone with a paintbrush!

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Sorry, I was busy hunting for my missing script. Still can't find it!

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: I was sound-checking the mic. Loud and clear, I was nowhere near the cake.

suspects.name: Nadia
suspects.line: Frosting? Me? I only lick the spoon when no one's looking.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: My hands are spotless, darling. I wouldn't dream of touching the cake.

clues.text: Fingerprints on the swapped costume show clean hands, no paint splattered on the sleeves. Whoever swapped it did not have paint on their fingers.
The last witness saw someone leave the green room just before the cake vanished. The culprit was last seen in the green room, minutes before the curtain was due.
A sports bottle was found refilled and untouched by the cooler, so its owner was not the one who stole the cake. Only the sports bottle is cleared.
A paper teacup was left beside the empty cake stand. Someone was carrying a paper teacup when they slipped away with the cake.
